overall_flow: App loads with dashboard showing no graph (insufficient data)
User views Systolic measurements and distribution
User switches to Diastolic tab to view diastolic distribution
User switches to Pulse tab to view pulse distribution
User scrolls down to view Metrics by Time of Day (polar/radar chart)
Polar visualization shows 24-hour measurement distribution by hour
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens and shows the main dashboard with 'Not enough data to draw a graph' message, but displays the latest measurement values (Systolic: 98, Diastolic: 70, Pulse: 123).
Step 2: The user navigates to the Statistics screen, which displays systolic blood pressure statistics including a value distribution chart (teal color) showing the range of systolic measurements.
Step 3: The user taps on the Diastolic tab to switch the view, and the distribution chart updates to show diastolic blood pressure data in green color.
Step 4: The user taps on the Pulse tab to switch the view, and the distribution chart updates to show pulse rate data in red color.
Step 5: The user scrolls down to view the 'Metrics by time of day' section, which displays a polar/radar chart showing how measurements are distributed across different hours of the day.
Step 6: The polar chart is fully visible, showing the complete 24-hour measurement distribution pattern with red shading indicating measurement intensity throughout the day.
